set_name: Larkspur Ridge Water District, Operations Building Addition and Yard Improvements, Permit Set 2026-07-30

candidates.candidate: Temporary barricades and dust partitions at all work areas while the existing operations building stays occupied, maintaining the existing egress path

Cross-sheet reference only; stays off the included list until the service scope is confirmed. See the open RFI.

candidates.candidate: Two 12 ft wide by 14 ft high insulated sectional overhead doors with electric operators at the Wash Bay 101 exterior wall

assumptions.text: The existing 12 in ductile iron water main across the site is protected in place and potholed for depth before excavation; no relocation is shown or carried.
Sound attenuation batts named in partition type P1 are carried inside the Division 09 partition assembly rather than separately in Division 07.

exclusions.text: Existing operations building finishes are not in contract.
Special inspections per IBC Chapter 17 are arranged and paid for by the owner.

rfis.text: A-601 is a scanned raster sheet and OCR recovered fewer than twenty words. Request a native PDF of the door and window schedule so door marks, frame types, glazing, and hardware sets can be read.

Room identification signage was recorded on the first pass against a sheet A-702 that is not in the sheet index and not in the set. No sheet in this set shows a signage schedule or a signage detail. Confirm whether ADA room identification signage is in the contract and issue the sheet or the specification section; nothing is carried as scope until then.
rfis.source: not stated in the set; G-000 sheet index lists 18 sheets and no A-702

rfis.text: An automatic transfer switch and standby generator connection were recorded on the first pass against a sheet E-401 that is not in the sheet index and not in the set. E-101 contains no one-line diagram, transfer switch, or generator connection. Confirm whether standby power is in the contract; nothing is carried as scope until a sheet shows it.
rfis.source: not stated in the set; G-000 sheet index lists 18 sheets and no E-401

rfis.text: C-201 keyed utility note 4 points to E-101 for the electrical service conduit and pull vault, but E-101 shows no service conduit, vault, transformer pad, one-line diagram, or panel schedule. Confirm who installs the service conduit and vault and issue the sheet that shows it.
rfis.source: C-201, keyed utility note 4; E-101 extracted text

rfis.text: No wall finish is scheduled for the gypsum board surfaces outside the Wash Bay 101 FRP wainscot. The A-501 finish schedule carries floor and ceiling codes only and no paint code appears anywhere in the set. Confirm the wall finish.

Follow-up. No hits for generator, transfer switch, ATS, standby, or camlock on any sheet. The first-pass transfer switch candidate cited a sheet E-401 that does not exist; it is an RFI, not scope.

coverage_ledger.reason: The G-000 index lists 18 sheets. The first-pass ledger listed 17 and left out C-501, and two first-pass candidates cited sheets A-702 and E-401 that the index does not contain. C-501 was read and added; A-702 and E-401 were removed from the candidates and recorded as RFIs.
